title: For IE users with "Advanced Privacy Settings" set to "Block 1st Party Cookies" and only allow transient (aka "session") cookies, Sails is creating a new session id on each request.

<hr/>

Sorry if this isn't the right place to post this but I'm at my wits end trying to find out why it's happening and how to resolve it and not got any response from Stack Overflow.

Basically the issue is only in IE when the Advanced Privacy Setting are set to Block 1st Party Cookies but allow session cookies. My understanding is this should allow the session cookie to be saved but this doesn't happen meaning every request creates a new session id and is leading to issues such as CSRF Mismatch.

I'm using the connect-mongo option for sessions. Please let me know if you need any extra info but as I don't really understand where the issue lies I don't know what to provide you at this point.
